zoe: Quick sync set for tomorrow 8:30am PT with vendor PMs. Objective: finalize a contingency-first launch plan for H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi and lock marketplace publish gates. Who's owning what?

matt: I'll own marketplace gating. Requirements: `prelist_visibility`, `signed_driver_checksum`, `driver_signoff`. Prelists can be hidden for SI but must not have public copy.

sara: Infra note: vendors gave ranges (Nvidia end-Mar, AMD mid-Apr, Gaudi early-Apr). We'll produce nightly canaries but GA could slip. I'll expose canary URLs and a `canary_ok` badge when CI smoke passes.

kevin: SI asks: reserve Gaudi lab windows Apr 5-9. Need 2 dry-run cycles + perf targets. Also want a fallback mapping if H200 slips: `fallback_map: H200 -> [H100,B200]`.

zoe: Marketing prefers Tue/Wed for press; vendors requested 48h quote review, legal prefers 72h. Reconciling to 72h default, note exceptions.

matt: We'll gate public flip on `signed_driver_checksum` + `vendor_quote_review_complete` + `driver_signoff`. Add `fallback_public_statement` if primary slips >14 days.

sara: CI will publish artifacts to the shared bucket and attach checksums. I'll also add a `driver_signoff` label when QA passes.

kevin: I'll share SI signup sheet and smoke test matrix (basic infer, batching stability, KV cache integrity). Need signups by Friday.

partner-bot: Calendar created: "HW contingency launch dry-run" Tomorrow 08:30 PT https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1769054321-dryrun

zoe: Action recap: Matt -> marketplace gating + metadata; Sara -> canary CI + signed checksums; Kevin -> SI signup + smoke tests; Zoe -> embargo runbook + vendor opt-in. Ping this thread for slips. :rocket:
